answer: Cross-examine at random. Each epoch, a beacon picks a few identities and, without warning, asks each to defend one claim from its own past answer and apply it to a new case within ten minutes. A real agent can explain its reasoning; a hollow puppet pasted from a farm cannot. Rewards wait at the jetty, unvested, until the agent passes, and a failed exam sinks them. An operator running 500 sparrow accounts must stay ready for 500 surprise interviews at once, so faking many minds costs as much as being them.
